prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the supplied Slopsidian Native application icon into a MUCH funnier, more bizarre and more unmistakably classic Linux Tux mascot. Keep recognizable seated black penguin, big white belly, yellow-orange beak and enormous flat yellow feet, and the violet notebook theme, but reinvent the tame generic 3D toy styling. Art-direct an absurd, mischievous open-source note-taking gremlin: classic slightly scruffy Tux with wildly excited googly eyes, tongue sticking out in concentration, a pencil tucked behind his head and a square violet sticky note stuck crookedly on his forehead. He is wrestling a chunky purple obsidian-crystal notebook that has sprung open like an accordion; a few large origami paper fish and absurdly looping notebook pages burst out above it, while one oversized yellow foot pins a runaway page down. His flipper furiously scribbles with an enormous yellow pencil; a small violet ink splat on his white belly makes the visual joke. Comical, anarchic, lovable, confident and visually ridiculous, like an eccentric Linux mascot drawn by an excellent editorial cartoonist. A tight readable icon silhouette, strong clean black outline, rich violet #8c70c9 and warm yellow accents, predominantly classic black-and-white Tux. Hand-drawn cartoon character with crisp production-quality edges and restrained cel shading, NOT a generic glossy 3D baby penguin. One single centered character and notebook, no scene or background, no square backplate, no actual letters, no labels, no watermark. The main Tux face, feet and purple notebook must stay clearly legible when shrunk to 64 pixels. Preserve a genuinely transparent alpha background around the entire silhouette. Make it as bizarre and funny as possible while still an excellent desktop app icon.
source: Generated for Slopsidian Native; revised at the user's request for a more classic, funny and bizarre Tux.

edits.purpose: Correct the lower-right foot at the user's request while preserving the rest of the artwork.
edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent Slopsidian Native Linux application icon.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Make one localized correction only: repair Tux's orange foot/leg in the lower-right corner (viewer right). It currently looks like a long swollen bent boot with a hand-like cluster of rounded toes. Replace it with a short, broad, flat classic Tux penguin webbed foot, with a coherent three-toe webbed silhouette, seated naturally on the loose paper. The leg should tuck plausibly under his black body behind the notebook rather than rising as a long orange tube. Keep the playful pose and balance, and make the corrected foot match the drawing language, orange/yellow shading, and black outline of the existing left foot. No human hand, no paw, no extra limb or separated digits.
Preserve all other artwork as closely as possible: exactly the same goofy Tux face, tongue, pencil, sticky note, black-and-white body, left foot, violet crystal notebook, accordion pages, origami fish, purple ink splashes, loose paper and composition. Keep the established crisp polished cartoon style and colors. Do not add any objects, text, border, background, or backplate. Preserve genuine transparency and the full uncropped square composition. Change only the lower-right foot and the minimum immediately adjacent connecting contour needed to make it anatomically coherent.
